useCase: Detecting AI generation artefactos through noise residual análisis using steganálisis techniques
mechanism: Aplica 30 hand-crafted high-pass filters from the Spatial Rich Model to extract noise residuals at different scales and orientations. These residuals capture subtle estadístico regularities in the noise domain. A Truncated Linear Unit (TLU) activation constrains residual values, enhancing discrimination entre natural sensor noise and synthetic patrón de ruidos.
accuracy: Alta - 83-91% for detecting synthetic patrón de ruidos
name: Análisis de Filtro SRM
source: Fridrich & Kodovský (2012) - Rich Models for Steganalysis of Digital Images, IEEE TIFS
algorithm: 30 SRM High-Pass Filters + Truncated Linear Unit
parameters: Filters: 30 SRM kernels (1st, 2nd, 3rd order), Truncation: T=3, Extracción de características: co-occurrence matrices, Histogram bins: 2T+1=7 per dimension
description: Aplica Spatial Rich Model (SRM) high-pass filters to extract noise residuals. Originally developed for steganálisis, these 30 hand-crafted filters effectively detect AI generation artefactos.

references.title: Fridrich, J. & Kodovský, J. (2012). Rich Models for Steganalysis of Digital Images. IEEE TIFS.
Zhou, P. et al. (2018). Learning Rich Features for Image Manipulation Detection. CVPR.

strengths:
• Captures diverse patrón de ruidos with 30 specialized filters
• Originally proven effective in steganálisis
• Multi-scale and multi-directional análisis
• Works well en imágenes de alta calidad
limitations:
• Computacionalmente intensivo with 30 filter passes
• Heavy compression destroys subtle patrón de ruidos
• Requires sufficient image resolución
• Performance varies a través de different AI architectures
